header.function_name: X8 Case Consolidation - Delivery Plan and ASN Draft

objective: To display the delivery plan per Customer Order Date with its status (Ready to ASN / Waiting Released), the cases and pieces released to supplier POs, and the ASN number when the cases are already grouped.
To display, for one selected Customer Order Date, the customer-order lines with Part No, quantity, supplier PO and case (Detail in Detail).
To select one Ready to ASN Customer Order Date and open the ASN Draft, so that all cases of that date are grouped into one ASN.
To enter the Delivery Date and Rit of the ASN, submit it (all cases of the date are locked) and display the submitted ASN read only.

screen_mode_remarks: 1) The check box of a Customer Order Date is enabled only when its status is Ready to ASN, its cases are not yet in an ASN and no other date is ticked (message no. 1 to 3 as tooltip of a disabled check box).
2) 'View detail' is hidden for the Supplier role, who only sees the Delivery Plan Header. Demand Supply and Procurement see the button (TBD: confirm role rule with business user).
3) Search and Reset return the screen to the Delivery Plan Header and clear the Detail Mode selection.
4) 'Download All Case Labels' is enabled only when the case list is not empty.
5) 'Submit ASN' is enabled only when the case list is not empty, 'Delivery Date' is filled and a Rit is available.
6) In ASN Submitted Mode the footer (Cancel, Submit ASN) is hidden; 'Back to Delivery Plan' in the title bar is used to leave the screen.

items.name: View detail

items.name: Selected date count

items.name: Selection summary

items.name: Clear selection
items.description: Unticks the selected date.

items.name: Group into 1 ASN
items.description: Opens the ASN Draft with all cases of the selected date.

items.name: Back to Delivery Plan
items.description: Returns to the Delivery Plan Header.

items.name: Customer Order Date
items.description: Date selected on the Delivery Plan Header.

items.name: Status (status pill)
items.description: Same rule as the Header status.

items.name: Supplier PO

items.name: Case summary

items.name: Customer Orders (count)
items.description: Number of distinct Customer Order numbers in the grid.

items.name: Part Nos (count)
items.description: Number of distinct Part No in the grid.

items.name: Cases (count)
items.description: Number of distinct cases in the grid. Waiting lines have no case and are not counted.

items.name: Customer Order

items.name: Destination

items.name: Customer Order Date

items.name: Customer Qty

items.name: Part No
items.description: Part number of the line. Bold.

items.name: Qty

items.name: PO No
items.description: Supplier PO that contains the case. Em dash for a Waiting line.

items.name: PO Date
items.description: Date of the supplier PO. '-' for a Waiting line.

items.name: Case No
items.description: Case number of the line. Badge 'Waiting' when the line has no PO yet; Waiting rows are highlighted.

items.name: Title / ASN No

items.name: Status badge
items.description: 'Draft' (grey) or 'Submitted' (green).

items.name: Information alert
items.description: Draft Mode: message no. 9. Submitted Mode: message no. 6.

items.name: ASN No

items.name: Supplier . Plant

items.name: Cases . Qty

items.name: Delivery Date
items.description: Delivery date of the ASN. Editable in Draft Mode only. Changing it reloads the Rit list.

items.name: Download All Case Labels
items.description: Downloads the labels of all cases in the ASN. Function TBD. Refer Screen Mode remark 4).

items.name: Seq

items.name: Case No
items.description: Case number, bold.

items.name: PO No
items.description: Supplier PO that contains the case.

items.name: Part No
items.description: Part number inside the case. A case with several Part Nos is shown as several rows.

items.name: Destination

items.name: Route

items.name: Qty

items: On first display the screen is in 'List Mode - No Selection'. 'Customer Order Date' From / To are blank and 'Status' is 'All'; all Customer Order Dates are listed without clicking 'Search'.
A Customer Order Date is listed when it has at least one case released to a supplier PO, or has quantity that is not released yet.
Rows are sorted by 'Customer Order Date' ascending. Header counts 'Dates', 'Ready' and 'Waiting' summarise the rows shown.
Rows with status Waiting Released are highlighted in amber and cannot be ticked.
Keep the entered criteria as the active search and clear any date opened in Detail Mode.
Retrieve the Customer Order Dates with 'Customer Order Date' >= From (if filled) and <= To (if filled).
If 'Status' = 'Ready to ASN' keep only Ready to ASN dates; if 'Waiting Released' keep only Waiting Released dates; if 'All' keep both.
If no date is found, display message no. 4. Otherwise display the Delivery Plan Header.

operation.text: If From is later than To the result is empty and message no. 4 is displayed (TBD: validation message to be confirmed).
User clicks 'Reset' button: clear From / To, set 'Status' to 'All', display all dates and return to the Delivery Plan Header.
User ticks the check box of a Customer Order Date.

items: Select all cases of that date, across all of its supplier POs. If every case of the date is already in an ASN, or the status is Waiting Released, the check box is disabled (message no. 1 or 2 as tooltip).
While one date is ticked, the check boxes of the other dates are disabled (message no. 3 as tooltip).
Show the Selection Bar with the date, number of cases, pieces and PO numbers, and enable 'Clear selection' and 'Group into 1 ASN'.
Unticking the same date clears the selection.

operation.text: User clicks 'Clear selection': untick the date and disable 'Clear selection' and 'Group into 1 ASN'.
User clicks 'Group into 1 ASN': open the ASN Draft with all cases of the selected Customer Order Date (5.3).
User clicks 'View detail' of a row: change to Detail Mode for that Customer Order Date (5.2). The button is not shown to the Supplier role.

items: A Customer Order Date is 'Ready to ASN' when every customer order of that date is paired with a supplier PO: all of its quantity is packed into full cases and every case is released in a PO. A date may be spread over several POs.
Otherwise the date is 'Waiting Released': some cases wait for a PO, or some pieces cannot form a full case yet. 'Cases' then shows the pieces not released.
One ASN covers exactly one Customer Order Date. A ready date is always grouped as a whole and cannot be split into another ASN.
Cases already in an ASN show the ASN number in 'ASN Number'. Once all cases of the date are in an ASN, the date is ticked and locked.

rows: Ready to ASN, already in ASN

items: Displayed when the user clicks 'View detail'. The Searching Criteria and Delivery Plan Header are hidden.
The summary shows 'Customer Order Date', status, supplier PO numbers and the case summary of the selected date.
The grid lists the customer-order lines of the date: first the lines assigned to cases (in PO order), then the lines Waiting for a PO.
One row per customer order and Part No inside each case. The same customer order may appear in several rows when split over several cases or POs.
For a Waiting line 'PO No' and 'PO Date' show '-' and 'Case No' shows 'Waiting'; the row is highlighted.
If there is no line, display message no. 5.
User clicks 'Back to Delivery Plan': return to the Delivery Plan Header in the current search state.
Detail in Detail is display only; no data is changed.
Opened from the Delivery Plan by 'Group into 1 ASN'. The scroll position goes to the top and the screen is in ASN Draft Mode.
The case list contains all cases of the selected Customer Order Date, across all of its POs, one row per case and Part No. Cases cannot be added or removed.
'ASN No' shows the number generated from the Delivery Date (note: 'auto . assigned on submit').
'Delivery Date' defaults to tomorrow (user local date). 'Rit' lists the Rits of that date and defaults to the first one; 'Route' shows the route of the chosen Rit.
The information alert shows message no. 9. If there is no case, display message no. 8.
When 'Delivery Date' is changed the Rit list is reloaded. The previous Rit is kept if it still exists on the new date; otherwise the first Rit is used.
Sunday has no Rit: 'Rit' shows 'No rit' and is disabled, 'Submit ASN' is disabled and message no. 7 is shown. Saturday has one Rit only.

operation.text: User clicks 'Back to Delivery Plan' or 'Cancel': leave the draft without submitting and display the Delivery Plan Header.

items: Reject the submission if the cases are not all the cases of one Customer Order Date, if the date is not Ready to ASN, or if Delivery Date / Rit is empty (message TBD).
Generate the ASN No from the Delivery Date.
Lock all cases of the Customer Order Date into the ASN and insert the ASN data (refer Data Edit Mapping).
Switch to ASN Submitted Mode: ASN No in the title, badge 'Submitted', message no. 6, Delivery Date and Rit read only, Cancel / Submit ASN hidden.
Clear the selection of the Delivery Plan. The date is shown as locked with its ASN Number in the Delivery Plan Header.

operation.text: User clicks 'Download All Case Labels': TBD - format, file name and content are not defined yet.

items: One ASN holds exactly one Customer Order Date, even when that date is spread over several POs. A case already in an ASN cannot be selected again.
Customer orders, supplier POs and cases are created by the PO release process, which is out of scope of this UISS.
Physical table and field names (Customer Order, Supplier PO, Case, ASN Header / Detail, Route Master) are TBD and must be confirmed by the project.
